verdict.rationale: Adyen Agentic covers the merchant side of product discovery: a feed API syncs catalogs to named AI platforms such as OpenAI and Meta, and agent platforms can run ACP/UCP checkout flows and tokenize credentials. The pack shows no API or endpoint that lets an arbitrary agent search products across merchants with keyless or self-service credentials. Discovery appears to flow through feeds pushed to specific large platforms rather than through an open search capability.
